description:
you save things all day — articles, threads, videos, half-ideas. most of them disappear into a folder you never open.

domino fixes that with one habit you already have: texting.

how it works
text any link or note to domino's number. that's it — saved. no app to open, no folder to choose.

domino reads what you save, connects it to everything else you've saved, and builds a quiet map of what you're into.

once a week, you get a digest: what you saved, what connects, and one thing worth another look.

the app
the iOS app is for everything after the save — browse your library, search it, chat with it, and save straight from Safari with the share extension.

what domino doesn't do
no ads. no selling your data. your saves aren't used to train AI models.

free while in beta.
whatsNew: initial App Store release — browse, search, and chat with everything you've saved via iMessage. includes Safari share extension.
